name: speshtv-roku
description: SpeshTV for Roku, based on Moonfin and Jellyfin Roku

scripts.build: node scripts/speshtv-assets.mjs && npx rimraf build/ out/ && npx bsc --project bsconfig.json --source-map=false --create-package false && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.test: node test/server-compatibility.mjs && node test/spesh-progress.mjs && node test/spesh-seerr-player.mjs && node test/live-audio-profile.mjs && node test/guide-modal-regression.mjs && node test/spesh-cinematic.mjs && node test/episode-context.mjs && node test/viewing-profiles.mjs

author: SpeshTV contributors
